reason: I would give it a try because the local, self-hosted setup fits my privacy concerns and I can use projects in my applications. I would still check that AI is actually optional and avoid connecting a provider until I understand what data it receives.
objection: The pitch says self-hosted, but I want to know whether my resume and application records stay on my machine and what is sent if I use AI.
would_change_my_mind: A concise data-flow explanation and a sample local-only setup using fake profile data.
